question: Who among the following musicians played Carnatic music with Ghatam?
solution:
The correct answer is **__TH Vinayakram.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **T H Vinayakram (also known as Vikku Vinayakram) **is a legendary **ghatam player **who use **clay pot percussion instrument **in the Indian classical music.
 
• His was honoured with prestigious awards like the **Padma Shri and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**
 
• Carnatic music originates in south India back over 2000 years.
 
• Some of the most revered composers in Carnatic music include: **Tyagaraja (1767–1847),** **Muthuswami Dikshitar (1775–****1835), Syama Sastri (1762–1827), Papanasam Sivan (1890–1973), Swathi Thirunal (1813-1846).**
 
• The primary elements of music are: **Raga, Tala, Kriti.**
 
• 
 
Carnatic music features several instruments. Some of the main ones include: **Veena, Mridangam, Violin, Flute, Ghatam.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramanand Raghvan **was famous **mridangan player**.
 
• He has major contribution in rhythmic section of Carnatic music.
 
• He also served as a faculty member at the Wesleyan University in the United States, promoting and teaching the art of mridangam percussion.
 
• **Ali Akbar Khan **was a **sarod player.** 
 
• Sarod is instrument related to **Hindustani Music.**
 
• He was known for his innovative and expressive performances.
 
• He founded **Ali Akbar College in California.**
 
• **K. V. Prasad **was famous Mridangan player in Carnatic music traditions 
 
• K.V. Prasad are not widely documented for their contribution.
